output_list.code: function mintToken(address target, uint256 mintedAmount) onlyOwner public{balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount;totalSupply += mintedAmount;}
output_list.reason: The mintToken function can be called by anyone, which means that anyone can mint new tokens and devalue the token. The totalSupply will be increased, but the balanceOf the target address will not be increased. This can be exploited to mint new tokens and devalue the token.
